title: US trade deals thrown into doubt after Trump's new tariffs
summary: The European ⁠Parliament decided on ​Monday to postpone a vote on the European ​Union's trade deal with the United States due to U.S. President Donald Trump's imposition of a blanket 15% import duty after ​the Supreme ‌Court struck down his previous ⁠global tariffs. Other countries too are re-examining deals with the US in light of the ruling.
